name: io.github.JohannsenLum/canvas-api-mcp
title: Canvas API MCP
description: MCP server exposing the Canvas LMS REST API (1,116 endpoints) for AI assistants

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Canvas LMS instance, e.g. https://yourschool.instructure.com

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Canvas API access token (Canvas: Account > Settings > New Access Token)

environmentVariables.name: CANVAS_MAX_PAGES
environmentVariables.description: Optional cap on the number of pages fetched per paginated Canvas API call
